evals.prompt: Generate a commercial prompt for an Amazon product listing of an ergonomic aluminum laptop stand.
evals.expected_output: Strict three-layer commercial prompt formatted for Amazon product photography standards.
expectations: Structured strictly with Layer 1 (Subject & Scene), Layer 2 (Style & Texture), and Layer 3 (Constraints)
Layer 3 specifies 1:1 aspect ratio suitable for Amazon hero product images
Layer 3 enforces pure white background (#FFFFFF) with product occupying ~85% of frame
Includes explicit negative constraints (NO text, NO watermarks, NO badges, NO packaging clutter)
Layer 2 specifies clean industrial commercial photography aesthetic and realistic material finishes
